source.source_text: transmit their readings to the care team weekly

parameters.name: instructions_text
parameters.default: Measure twice in the morning before medications and twice in the evening, one minute apart.

parameters.name: reminder_text
parameters.default: Please submit this week's home blood pressure readings.

parameters.name: escalation_reason
parameters.default: No home blood pressure readings after reminders.

parameters.name: notify_reason

automatability.rationale: The guideline gives a repeatable monitoring cadence, thresholds, reminder limit, and escalation path.

process.name: Home blood pressure monitoring with outreach and escalation

provenance.source_text: take two readings one minute apart in the morning before medications and two readings one minute apart in the evening ... and transmit their readings to the care team weekly
transmit their readings to the care team weekly
The care team reviews the weekly average systolic and diastolic readings
The care team reviews the weekly average systolic and diastolic readings
If a week passes without readings, a reminder should be sent to the patient
After three reminder attempts on different days without readings, the care team should contact the patient directly
The responsible clinician should be notified when the weekly home average is 135/85 mmHg or higher ... routine notification
The care team reviews the weekly average systolic and diastolic readings
after three reminder attempts on different days

        </bpmn2:dataInputAssociation>

      <bpmn2:scriptTask id="remind_counter" name="Count reminder attempts" scriptFormat="http://www.java.com/java">

          <acp:element><![CDATA[{}]]></acp:element>
        </bpmn2:extensionElements>
        <bpmn2:incoming>remind_counter_in</bpmn2:incoming>
        <bpmn2:outgoing>f_attempts</bpmn2:outgoing>
        <bpmn2:script>kcontext.setVariable("reminder_attempts", ((Integer) kcontext.getVariable("reminder_attempts")) + 1);</bpmn2:script>

      <bpmn2:task id="request_readings" name="Request home BP readings" drools:taskName="patient.request_observation">

          <acp:element><![CDATA[{"provenance":{"kind":"source","source_text":"take two readings one minute apart in the morning before medications and two readings one minute apart in the evening ... and transmit their readings to the care team weekly"}}]]></acp:element>
        </bpmn2:extensionElements>
        <bpmn2:incoming>f_loop</bpmn2:incoming>
        <bpmn2:outgoing>f_wait</bpmn2:outgoing>

          <bpmn2:dataInput id="request_readings_code_input" name="code" drools:dtype="String"/>
          <bpmn2:dataInput id="request_readings_due_input" name="due" drools:dtype="String" itemSubjectRef="_strItem"/>
          <bpmn2:dataInput id="request_readings_instructions_input" name="instructions" drools:dtype="String" itemSubjectRef="_strItem"/>
          <bpmn2:dataInput id="request_readings_TaskName" name="TaskName" drools:dtype="Object"/>

          </bpmn2:assignment>
        </bpmn2:dataInputAssociation>
        <bpmn2:dataInputAssociation>
          <bpmn2:sourceRef>reporting_interval</bpmn2:sourceRef>
          <bpmn2:targetRef>request_readings_due_input</bpmn2:targetRef>
        </bpmn2:dataInputAssociation>
        <bpmn2:dataInputAssociation>
          <bpmn2:sourceRef>instructions_text</bpmn2:sourceRef>
          <bpmn2:targetRef>request_readings_instructions_input</bpmn2:targetRef>
        </bpmn2:dataInputAssociation>
        <bpmn2:dataInputAssociation>
          <bpmn2:targetRef>request_readings_TaskName</bpmn2:targetRef>
          <bpmn2:assignment>
            <bpmn2:from xsi:type="bpmn2:tFormalExpression">patient_request_observation__request_readings</bpmn2:from>
            <bpmn2:to xsi:type="bpmn2:tFormalExpression">request_readings_TaskName</bpmn2:to>
          </bpmn2:assignment>
        </bpmn2:dataInputAssociation>

      <bpmn2:intermediateCatchEvent id="wait_interval" name="Reporting interval elapsed">
        <bpmn2:extensionElements>
          <acp:element><![CDATA[{"provenance":{"kind":"source","source_text":"transmit their readings to the care team weekly"}}]]></acp:element>

      </bpmn2:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn2:sequenceFlow id="f_end_escalated" sourceRef="escalate" targetRef="end_escalated_outcome">
        <bpmn2:extensionElements>

        </bpmn2:extensionElements>
      </bpmn2:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn2:sequenceFlow id="end_escalated_outcome_out" sourceRef="end_escalated_outcome" targetRef="main_end_escalated">

          <acp:element><![CDATA[{}]]></acp:element>
        </bpmn2:extensionElements>

      <bpmn2:sequenceFlow id="f_escalate" sourceRef="gw_attempts" targetRef="escalate" name="limit reached">
        <bpmn2:extensionElements>
          <acp:element><![CDATA[{"conditionExpression":"reminder_attempts >= max_reminder_attempts","provenance":{"kind":"source","source_text":"after three reminder attempts on different days"}}]]></acp:element>
        </bpmn2:extensionElements>
        <bpmn2:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn2:tFormalExpression" language="http://www.java.com/java"><![CDATA[return reminder_attempts != null && max_reminder_attempts != null && reminder_attempts >= max_reminder_attempts;]]></bpmn2:conditionExpression>
      </bpmn2:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn2:sequenceFlow id="f_high" sourceRef="gw_threshold" targetRef="notify" name="above threshold">
        <bpmn2:extensionElements>
          <acp:element><![CDATA[{"conditionExpression":"avg_systolic >= notify_systolic_threshold or avg_diastolic >= notify_diastolic_threshold","provenance":{"kind":"source","source_text":"weekly home average is 135/85 mmHg or higher"}}]]></acp:element>
        </bpmn2:extensionElements>
        <bpmn2:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn2:tFormalExpression" language="http://www.java.com/java"><![CDATA[return (avg_systolic != null && notify_systolic_threshold != null && avg_systolic >= notify_systolic_threshold) || (avg_diastolic != null && notify_diastolic_threshold != null && avg_diastolic >= notify_diastolic_threshold);]]></bpmn2:conditionExpression>

      <bpmn2:sequenceFlow id="f_loop" sourceRef="loop_entry" targetRef="request_readings">

      <bpmn2:sequenceFlow id="f_none" sourceRef="gw_received" targetRef="remind" name="no">

        </bpmn2:extensionElements>
      </bpmn2:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn2:sequenceFlow id="f_notified" sourceRef="notify" targetRef="loop_entry">
        <bpmn2:extensionElements>
          <acp:element><![CDATA[{}]]></acp:element>
        </bpmn2:extensionElements>
      </bpmn2:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn2:sequenceFlow id="f_ok" sourceRef="gw_threshold" targetRef="loop_entry" name="within target">
        <bpmn2:extensionElements>
          <acp:element><![CDATA[{}]]></acp:element>
        </bpmn2:extensionElements>
      </bpmn2:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn2:sequenceFlow id="f_query" sourceRef="wait_interval" targetRef="query_systolic">
        <bpmn2:extensionElements>
          <acp:element><![CDATA[{}]]></acp:element>
        </bpmn2:extensionElements>
      </bpmn2:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn2:sequenceFlow id="f_query2" sourceRef="query_systolic" targetRef="query_diastolic">
        <bpmn2:extensionElements>
          <acp:element><![CDATA[{}]]></acp:element>
        </bpmn2:extensionElements>
      </bpmn2:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn2:sequenceFlow id="f_received" sourceRef="query_diastolic" targetRef="gw_received">
        <bpmn2:extensionElements>
          <acp:element><![CDATA[{}]]></acp:element>

      <bpmn2:sequenceFlow id="f_retry" sourceRef="gw_attempts" targetRef="loop_entry" name="try again">

          <acp:element><![CDATA[{}]]></acp:element>
        </bpmn2:extensionElements>

      <bpmn2:sequenceFlow id="f_some" sourceRef="gw_received" targetRef="f_some_reset" name="yes">

      </bpmn2:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn2:sequenceFlow id="f_some_reset_out" sourceRef="f_some_reset" targetRef="gw_threshold">
        <bpmn2:extensionElements>
          <acp:element><![CDATA[{}]]></acp:element>
        </bpmn2:extensionElements>
      </bpmn2:sequenceFlow>
      <bpmn2:sequenceFlow id="f_start" sourceRef="main_start" targetRef="loop_entry">
        <bpmn2:extensionElements>
          <acp:element><![CDATA[{}]]></acp:element>

      <bpmn2:extensionElements>
        <acp:element><![CDATA[{}]]></acp:element>
      </bpmn2:extensionElements>
    </bpmn2:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn2:sequenceFlow id="f_main" sourceRef="init" targetRef="main">
      <bpmn2:extensionElements>
        <acp:element><![CDATA[{}]]></acp:element>
      </bpmn2:extensionElements>
    </bpmn2:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn2:sequenceFlow id="f_after" sourceRef="main" targetRef="gw_outcome">
      <bpmn2:extensionElements>
        <acp:element><![CDATA[{}]]></acp:element>
      </bpmn2:extensionElements>

        <acp:element><![CDATA[{}]]></acp:element>
      </bpmn2:extensionElements>
